title: No open exact-root cover for Vassiliev’s quadratic family

initial.assessment: Exact manuscript and all three original PDF pages read. Reconstruct local square-root obstruction on the whole preimage of an open parameter neighborhood, including domain translations.

proof: For any open coefficient neighborhood of zero, its preimage under the fixed linear coefficient slice contains a disk. The entire real solution set, with all candidate roots, is the complex squaring equation on that disk.

Along the piecewise linear path 1→i→−1, the squared image scaled by c² closes and stays in the disk, while the lift stays nonzero and switches sign. The ratio of a purported continuous lift to the explicit lift is a continuous map of a connected interval into {±1} and cannot change sign. Endpoints force the opposite result. A separate degree argument gives 2 deg = 1 on the small circle.

Translation by h,k gives the exact printed family of nonzero obstructed coefficients. A neighborhood of p(1,0) in the space with zero removed still contains an ordinary Euclidean neighborhood of that point. This rules out deletion of zero alone. For approximate roots the exact sign obstruction is insufficient; small roots lie within the stated epsilon neighborhood of zero.
